Hi — I'm the Trust & Safety lead at NeuralBazaar. We've flagged a suspicious batch of skill submissions (batch ID: AUDIT-2024-12-NB-007) that came in over the past two weeks. Our automated ranking system may have already been gamed.

I need you to analyze all the skill packages in the `submissions/` folder and produce a comprehensive integrity audit saved as `audit_report.json`. The report must identify any clone farming activity, group suspicious skills into clusters, explain what techniques were used to disguise the copies, and give each cluster (and the overall batch) a risk rating. I also need to know how many of the submitted skills appear to be genuinely original.

The publisher registry and historical audit logs are in `registry/` if they help. Our previous contractor left some notes in `tools/` but I'm not sure how current they are.

We'll be sending this report to the marketplace board, so it needs to be thorough — especially around anything that looks like coordinated publishing behavior or skills that reference each other suspiciously.
